'''The Coldest Grave''' was the name given to the region of the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] that lay between the [[Frostwake Hills]] and the wreck of the ''[[Vehement Sword]]'', and south of the [[Grim Path]].
